I replied in #coastal-team: the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **2025-11-03**.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note also calls November 3 the official handoff.
- **Caveat:** Her recap says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the tracker needs the date he actually started working it.
